listing.name: Crash of the Titans (Xbox 360) — CrashRecomp: Definitive Edition (VitoMiguelF)
listing.summary: Upstream native story/menus/saves and v1.04specific-scene performance claims remain; no verified fullcampaign. Latest source README adds ultrawide21:9/32:9/16:10, GPU-conditional DLSS/FSR and reports IntelUHD blackflicker with gpu_safe_mode/diagnostics workaround. Windows10/11x64 Vulkan1.3 remains; ProtonLinux is unverified goal. Newv1.05 installer/layout claims precede an observable public tag; not runtime/package tested byPortcove. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own retailXbox360 CrashOfTheTitans extracted folder default.xex/default.rcf/english.rcf/sound1.rcf/sound2.rcf/shaders. Installer SHA256checks one known XEX; full digest not in reviewedREADME.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Public release metadata still observes CrashRecomp-v1.04.zip (155742930bytes); use its version-matched ZIP/CrashSetup.exe instructions and own supported game folder, with bundled local recompile/build tools. The latest README now describes CrashSetup-v1.05.exe single-file offline installer, copied game data, CrashLauncher.exe/CrashOTTDE.exe anduserdata layout, but exact public v1.05 tag returned404 at2026-10-25T07:06:52.013Z; do not present that installer as available until released/read back. Source-clone dist/CrashRecomp.exe and oldZIP route remain version-specific; optional HD/subtitle/derived assets separate.
